text:
mika: Quick weekend check — debating between a mellow scone-bake at the Marina kitchen (3pm) or a paddleboard meetup on the lake (10:30). Reply with `scone` or `paddle` and any timing constraints. :scone: :canoe:
danny: scone! been testing a rosemary-cheddar batch, 3pm works for me :drooling_face:
sara: paddle if the water's not too chilly. what’s the backup time if it’s windy? @mika
mika: backup is raincheck / next weekend — lean 10:30 for paddle, 3pm for scones. flexible though
ops-bot: Reminder: shared kitchen reservation required for groups >4. Use `/reserve kitchen 15:00` if you're bringing more than 4 people.
alex: scone for me but only after 5pm — can I still swing by later? also can bring a jar of starter if needed
tess: :thumbsup: scone. I’ll bring preserves and butter.
danny: if we go paddle, I’ve got a spare pump and a life vest to share. can bring both to office beforehand
sara: okay, leaning scone now that alex and tess are in. vote: scone
mika: current tally: scone x4 (mika, danny, alex, tess), paddle x2 (sara + danny maybe). tentative plan: scone at 3pm in Marina kitchen; paddle stays a possibility at 10:30 if a few more join. anyone need a ride?
lee: can drive two people — leaving office 2:45. ping me here with a 👍 to reserve a spot
mika: sweet. I’ll open a tiny poll and update the thread. thanks y’all! :sparkles:
